title: Bianchi’s €100 Million Lesson: You Can’t Mass-Produce Heritage
content:
Bianchi built a volume-focused factory when it should have protected its prestige. Here is why the world's oldest bike brand must pivot its strategy and return to what it does best.

Read the full article at Bianchi’s €100 Million Lesson: You Can’t Mass-Produce Heritage on Velo.
author: Josh Ross
